lines.text: When the scattered people return to the LORD and obey Him, He will gather them from all the nations.
The LORD will circumcise their hearts so they love Him, and He will put the curses on their enemies.
The commandment is not in heaven or beyond the Red Sea, but very near, in their mouth and heart.
If Israel bows to other gods, they will surely perish, and Moses calls the elders as witnesses.
The LORD is their life, and He will prolong their days in the land He swore to their fathers.
